children: -- Comstock Inc. (NYSE American: LODE) (“Comstock” and the “Company”) is pleased to announce that the Company’s CEO, Corrado De Gasperis, and CFO, Judd Merrill will provide an overview of our third quarter 2026 financial results and current business updates on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 4:30pm ET. We invite our investors and all other interested parties to register for the webinar at the link below.
The call includes a live presentation and a Q&A session. You may submit your question(s) beforehand in the registration form (linked above) or by email at:

innovates and commercializes technologies, systems and supply chains that enable, support and sustain clean energy systems by efficiently, effectively, and expediently extracting and converting under-utilized natural resources into reusable metals, like silver, aluminum, and other critical minerals, primarily from end-of-life photovoltaics and renewable fuels, chemicals and animal feedstocks, primarily derived from proprietary crops and other forms of woody biomass for energy.
To learn more, please visit www.comstock.inc.

Comstock Inc. has used, and intends to continue using, its investor relations link and main website at www.comstock.inc in addition to its X.com, LinkedIn and YouTube accounts, as means of disclosing material non-public information and for complying with its disclosure obligations under Regulation FD.
Judd B. Merrill, Chief Financial Officer
Zach Spencer, Director of External Relations
